pie: ǵʰéwtōr tom h₃rḗǵm̥ wewked: "h₁yáǵeswo deywóm wérunom".
english: The priest said to the king: "Pray to the god Werunos."

pie: nu gʷm̥tā́m dwóh₁ mórtoh₁ h₃réǵm̥. nu h₁óynos h₂éǵt. nu moy h₁éḱwoh₁ h₁ésti. nu h₁énos wéwket. nu dʰrugʰyéti. nu moy só h₁éḱwos h₁ésti. nu só h₃rḗǵs sékʷt. nu h₂éǵroy sth₂tóm HrudHtóm-kʷe. nu h₁ím léh₁oh₂. nu h₁éy h₁énom gʷéh₂t. nu h₁ésmey sékʷt. nu toy h₁éy h₁ésti. nu h₁óynos h₁ím h₂epó déwkt.
english: Two men came to the king. One said: "The stallion is mine." That one said: "He lies. The stallion is mine." The king said: "Stand in the field and cry out. I shall let it go." It went to that one. Then he said to him: "It is yours." The first man led the stallion away.

pie: h₁yós h₃rēǵéy dʰrówgʰom wérh₁eti nu tósyo wékʷos h₂ew mē ḱléwseto wóyḱōd-kʷe h₁éǵʰs h₁éytu. h₁yós dʰrówgʰom ḱléweti h₃rēǵéy-kʷe h₁ím wérh₁eti misdʰós tósmey h₁éstu. h₁léwdʰerosyo wékʷos diwéy lewbʰóm.
english: Whoever speaks a lie to the king, let the word of that man not be heard again, and let him go out of the settlement. Whoever hears a lie and tells it to the king, let him have a reward. The word of a free man is dear to the sky.

pie: nu h₁ludʰét towdós swesrés ph₂térm̥ bʰéh₂t-kʷe. nu wédʰmn̥ déh₃m̥. nu moy toy swésorm̥ h₁áydʰi. nu só ph₂tḗr wérh₁yet. nu moy tód wédʰmn̥ ne dédeh₃s. nu méh₂tēr mléwHt. nu déḱm̥ h₂ówins ǵʰórtoy widóm. nu só ph₂tḗr wérh₁t. nu h₁íh₂es wédʰmn̥. nu toy h₁íh₂m̥ ḱóymom wédʰe. nu méh₂tr̥s ḱḗr méwdt.
english: The driver came to the father of the sister and said: "I gave the bride price. Give me your sister." The father said: "You gave me no bride price." The mother spoke: "I saw ten sheep in the pen." The father said: "They are a bride price. Lead her to your home." The heart of the mother was glad.

pie: h₁yód ḱwṓ pórḱom ǵʰórtoy moréyēti nu h₁ésyo pótnih₂ suHnówey h₂ówim h₁áytu. h₁yód wĺ̥kʷom moréyēti nu kʷid mē dédeh₃t. h₁yód ḱwṓ h₂eh₃méh₂m h₂éwim h₁édeti nu h₁íh₂m̥ ḱéletu.
english: If a dog kills a piglet in the pen, let its mistress give a sheep to the son. If he kills a wolf, let her give nothing. If a dog eats a raw bird, let her cover it.

pie: nu h₂nḗr poh₂iménh₁e h₃réǵm̥ wédʰet wérh₁yet-kʷe. nu moy h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m lémbʰt misdʰóm-kʷe ne déh₃t. nu só poh₂imḗn mléwHt. nu tóm misdʰóm kʷéyom. nu moy swésōr h₁ím widét. nu swésor wr̥h₁dʰí. nu h₁íh₂ h₂éǵt. nu h₁ésmey tóm misdʰóm h₂én h₁áyt. nu só h₃rḗǵs wéwket. nu tósyo wékʷos dʰrówgʰos. nu só h₁ésmey h₁éḱwom dédeh₃tu. nu swesrés h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm.
english: The man led the shepherd to the king and said: "He seized my wool and gave no wage." The shepherd said: "I paid the wage. My sister saw it. Sister, speak!" She spoke: "He gave him the wage there." The king said: "His word is a lie. Let him give him a stallion." Then the sister's name was famous.

pie: nu ḱósyo wóyḱosyo h₂néres h₁énosyo wóyḱosyo h₂nr̥bʰós bʰóydʰeh₂es dʰh₁ént. nu wos gʷṓs h₂epó mē h₂éǵōmes. nu nos deywṓs wékʷos h₂wiséntu. nu h₁yós ḱā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépeti tósyo stéh₂dʰh₁om n̥ḱyéh₁t. nu nos suHnéwes gʷíh₃woyh₁ent. nu dwóh₁ wóyḱoh₁ ḱéywoh₁ h₁stā́m. nu nos dyḗws upér h₂wisyéh₁t.
english: The men of this settlement made an oath to the men of that settlement. We shall not drive away your cattle. May the gods hear our word. Whoever breaks this oath, may his herd vanish. May our sons live. Let the two settlements be friendly. May the sky above hear us.

pie: nu súHnew ḱā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m dʰh₁dʰí wr̥h₁dʰí-kʷe. nu wóyḱosyo gʷṓs ne h₂éǵom. nu deywóns mē dʰréwgʰs. h₁yód dʰrugʰyḗsi tóy te deywṓs mē h₂wisih₁ént. nu moy ḱḗr méwdeti. nu moy túH lewbʰós.
english: Son, make this oath and speak: I did not drive the cattle of the settlement. Do not deceive the gods. If you lie, may the gods not hear you. Then my heart will rejoice. You are dear to me.

pie: nu wódr̥ h₁éymi. nu moy déywōs ḱḗr dedr̥ḱé. nu moy wékʷos ne dʰrówgʰos. h₁yód dʰrugʰyṓh₂ h₁ógʷʰis me gʷr̥h₃óyh₁t. h₁yód mē dʰrugʰyṓh₂ tód me wódr̥ h₁éǵʰs bʰéroyh₁t. nu ne dedwóyh₂e.
english: I go into the water. Gods, you see my heart. My word is not a lie. If I deceive, may the snake devour me. If I do not deceive, may the water carry me out. I am not afraid.

pie: nu gʰóstis mórtosyo ḱóymom nékʷti gʷémt. nu só mórtos h₁ím h₂epó h₁élh₂t. nu ḱós h₃rēǵéy sékʷt. nu moy péh₂wr̥ wódr̥-kʷe ne h₁opéyet. nu me h₂epó h₂éǵet. nu só mórtos bʰéh₂t. nu h₁ím ne ǵnéh₃m̥. nu só h₃rḗǵs wérh₁yet. nu só gʰóstis deywóybʰos lewbʰós. nu h₁ésmey tód péh₂wr̥ tód-kʷe wódr̥ dh₃dʰí h₁éy-kʷe toy ḱóymoy tḱéytu. nu h₁éy sédt pótnih₂-kʷe h₁ím woséyet.
english: A guest came in the night to the home of the mortal. The mortal drove him away. This one said to the king: "He gave me neither fire nor water. He drove me away." The mortal said: "I did not know him." The king said: "A guest is dear to the gods. Give him fire and water, and let him dwell in your home." The guest sat down, and the mistress clothed him.

pie: h₁yós wóyḱosyo dʰéyǵʰos Hrunépeti nu só h₁íd h₂ew démetu. h₁yód snígʷʰs h₁íd gléwbʰēti nu kʷis mē kʷéyet. h₁yód ǵʰwḗr pótn̥yeh₂s ǵʰórtom dérēti nu h₁ím démetu. dʰéyǵʰos stéh₂eti h₁léwdʰerōs-kʷe h₁íd péh₂sonti.
english: Whoever breaks the wall of the settlement, let that man build it again. But if the snow splits it, let no one pay. If a wild animal tears up the pen of a mistress, let her build it. The wall shall stand, and the free men shall guard it.

pie: akwāsas ā wawakant: krudʰi awai, kard agʰnutai wiwidwant- swas: manus patis warnām awisāms karnauti swabʰyam gʰarmam wastram awibʰyams ka warnā na asti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: nu bʰréh₂terh₁e bʰoydʰéh₂m dʰh₁tā́m. nu stéh₂dʰh₁om ḱóm h₁élh₂owos. h₁yód h₁óynos bʰéwgeti h₁énos h₁ím h₁pyéh₁t. nu nos méh₂tēr ḱléwos dedr̥ḱyéh₁t. nu nos stéh₂dʰh₁om h₂uksyéh₁t. nu nos h₁nómn̥ ǵénh₁esi méǵh₂ h₁syéh₁t.
english: The two brothers made the oath. Together we shall drive the herd. If one flees, let that one seize him. May our mother see our fame. May our herd grow. May our name be great among the kin.

pie: h₂ówis tu h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os weukʷét, "ḱḗr Hegʰnutór moi h₁éḱwons Héǵontm̥ Hnérm̥ widn̥tbʰ(y)os."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: h₁yód gʷéwōm stéh₂dʰh₁eh₂ h₁léwdʰerosyo h₂éǵrom wéyḱeti h₁édeti-kʷe. poh₂imḗn h₁ésmey dwóyh₁ h₂ówih₁ wédʰetu. h₁yód stéh₂dʰh₁om h₁ésmōd h₁éǵʰs h₂éǵēti nu kʷid mē h₁áyt. stéh₂dʰh₁om bʰr̥h₁wéni píph₃etu.
english: If a herd of cattle enters the field of a free man and eats, let the shepherd lead two sheep to him. If he drives the herd out of it at once, let him give nothing. Let the herd drink at the spring.

pie: nu ǵʰwḗr tríns pórḱons nékʷti gʷr̥h₃ét. nu poh₂imḗn wiHróm gʷémt dedwóye-kʷe. nu sékʷt. nu moy tóns pórḱons ḱunéh₁ h₂léksom. nu moy ḱwṓ h₁ím widét. nu só wiHrós bʰéh₂t. nu só ḱwṓ ne mléwHti. nu ḱós wérh₁yet. nu h₁eǵóh₂ ne bʰṓr. nu mléwHt. nu túH ne bʰṓr. nu h₁íns ne h₂lékses. nu deywóybʰos h₁óynom h₁éḱwom h₁opéye. nu ḱós sédt.
english: In the night a wild animal devoured three piglets. The shepherd came to the hero, and he was afraid. He said: "I guarded the piglets with my dog. My dog saw it." The hero said: "The dog does not speak." This one said: "I am not a thief." Then he said: "You are not a thief. You did not guard them. Give the gods one stallion." Then he sat down.

pie: nu ḱód dʰéyǵʰos h₂éǵroy démome. nu h₁yós h₁íd Hrunépeti swṓs gʷówes bʰugih₁ént. nu tód dʰéyǵʰos sth₂yéh₁t. nu sóh₂wl̥ h₁íd dedr̥ḱyéh₁t. nu ǵʰwḗr h₁íd mē déroyh₁t. nu tód dʰéyǵʰos bʰl̥Hós méǵh₂-kʷe h₁syéh₁t.
english: We built this wall in the field. Whoever breaks it, may his own cattle flee. May the wall stand. May the sun see it. May no beast tear it down. May the wall be white and great.

pie: gʰóstim kʷis mē moréyet. h₁éy deywóybʰos lewbʰós h₁éstu. h₁éy sédtu pótnih₂-kʷe h₁ím woséyetu. h₁yós h₁ím moréyēti nu h₃rḗǵs tóm h₁éǵʰs h₁élh₂tu.
english: Let no one kill a guest. Let him be dear to the gods. Let him sit, and let the mistress clothe him. Whoever kills him, let the king drive that man out.

pie: nu me n̥mr̥tóm péh₂wr̥ spéḱye. nu swósyo bʰréh₂tr̥s h₁éḱwom ne klépom. nu h₁ím ǵʰórtōd h₁éǵʰs ne h₁élh₂m̥. h₁yód h₁ím klépom h₁éwsoyh₁s me. nu moy suHnús ḱḗr ǵn̥néh₃ti. nu túH HeHḱús h₂r̥ǵrós-kʷe.
english: Immortal fire, look at me! I did not steal the stallion of my brother. I did not drive it out of the pen. If I stole it, may you burn me. My son knows my heart. You are swift and shining.

pie: h₁yód h₂nḗr swésorm̥ ḱóymom wédʰēti nu h₁ésyeh₂s méh₂trey wédʰmn̥ déh₃tu. h₁íh₂ h₁léwdʰereh₂ h₁éstu. h₁yód h₁íd ne h₁áyeti nu méh₂tēr swésorm̥ h₂ew wédʰetu.
english: If a man leads a sister to his home, let him give the bride price to her mother. Let her be free. If he does not give it, let the mother lead the sister back.

pie: h₁yós h₂éwim tn̥tlṓd sléh₂gʷeti só bʰṓr. h₁yód h₃éronm̥ sléh₂gʷeti nu h₃rēǵéy h₁éḱwom déh₃tu. h₁yós h₂éwim tn̥tlṓd h₂pó léh₁eti nu tn̥tlóm tḗtḱtu. h₃érō dyéwes lewbʰós.
english: Whoever snatches a bird from the net, that man is a thief. If he snatches an eagle, let him give the king a stallion. Whoever lets the bird away from the net, let him make a net. The eagle is dear to the sky.

pie: swesrés kʷis h₂éǵrom mē h₂érh₃yet. h₁yód h₂nḗr h₁ím h₂érh₃yēti nu dwóyh₁ tósyo yugóyh₁ h₁éptu. h₁yód tósyo gʷówes h₂éǵrom wéyḱonti h₁édeti-kʷe só h₁ésyeh₂ey h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m h₁opéyetu.
english: Let no one plough the field of his sister. If a man ploughs it, let her seize the two yokes of that man. If the cattle of that man enter the field and eat, let him give her wool.

pie: nu h₁éwseto h₁léwdʰerosyo gʷowsth₂ós nékʷti. nu h₁éy towdṓy wéwket. nu toy moy péh₂wr̥ gʷowsth₂óm h₁éwset. nu só towdós sékʷt. nu h₁ím ne h₁éwsom. nu h₂énh₁mos h₁íd tóm gʷowsth₂óm bʰéret. nu pótnih₂ bʰéh₂t. nu kʷid mē h₁opéyet. nu h₁ím h₂ew ḱóm démōmes. nu só towdós h₁léwdʰeros-kʷe tóm gʷowsth₂óm h₂ew démetām.
english: In the night the stall of the free man burned. He said to the driver: "Your fire burned my stall." The driver said: "I did not burn it. The wind carried it into the stall." The mistress said: "Let no one give anything. Let us build the stall again together." The driver and the free man built the stall again.

pie: nu h₃réǵ h₁eǵóh₂ ne bʰṓr. nu h₁éḱwons ne lémbʰm̥. nu h₂éǵroy h₁ésm̥. nu h₁éyes n̥ḱént. nu moy ḱwṓ tóm bʰórm̥ kʷéḱt. h₁yód dʰrugʰyṓh₂ wĺ̥kʷos moy ḱḗr h₁édih₁t.
english: King, I am not a thief. I did not seize the stallions. I was in the field. They vanished. My dog caught sight of the thief. If I deceive, may the wolf eat my heart.

pie: nu dʰéh₁t mórtos bʰoydʰéh₂m h₃rḗǵi. nu moy bʰréh₂tr̥s h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m ne lémbʰm̥. nu só bʰréh₂tēr h₂éǵt. nu dʰréwgʰs. nu te nékʷti widóm. nu toy séh₂ h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ ḱóymoy h₁ésti. nu só mórtos wéwket. nu moy deywṓs ḱḗr dedr̥ḱḗr. nu só h₃rḗǵs sékʷt. nu h₁éyes h₁íd dedr̥ḱḗr. nu dʰréwgʰs. nu h₁ésmey misdʰóm kʷéye. nu só tóm misdʰóm dédeh₃t tósyo-kʷe h₁nómn̥ ne ḱlutóm.
english: A mortal made the oath before the king: "I did not seize the wool of my brother." The brother said: "You deceived. I saw you in the night. The wool is in your home." The mortal said: "The gods see my heart." The king said: "They see it. You deceived. Pay him the wage." Then he gave the wage, and his name was not famous.

pie: nu suHnús gʷéwōm lóyseh₂m sékʷeto wiHrósyo-kʷe ḱóymom h₁ludʰét. nu h₁íns ǵʰórtoy kʷéḱt. nu h₃réǵm̥ gʷémt mléwHt-kʷe. nu moy gʷówes tósyo ǵʰórtoy h₁sénti. nu séh₂ lóyseh₂ tóm h₁éyti. nu só h₃rḗǵs tósmey wiHrṓy wérh₁t. h₁éyes toy ǵʰórtom kʷíh₁ gʷmént? nu só wiHrós wéwket. nu ne ǵn̥néh₃mi. nu h₂éǵt. nu túH bʰṓr. nu tósmey suHnówey h₁íns h₂ew dukdʰí. nu só suHnús h₁íns tósmōd ǵʰórtōd h₁éǵʰs h₂éǵet.
english: The son followed the track of his cattle and arrived at the home of the hero. He saw the cattle in the pen. He came to the king and said: "My cattle are in his pen. The track goes to him." The king said to the hero: "How did they come into your pen?" The hero said: "I do not know." Then he said: "You are the thief. Lead them back to the son." The son drove the cattle out of the pen.

pie: nu h₁ludʰétām dwóh₁ suHnúh₁ swóm ph₂térm̥. nu h₁óynos mléwHt. nu moy ḱós h₂éǵros h₁ésti. nu h₁énos h₂éǵt. nu tósyo wékʷos dʰrówgʰos. nu moy h₁ím h₁áys. nu só ph₂tḗr wéwket. kʷís h₁ím h₂érh₃yet? nu h₁óynos sékʷt. nu h₁ím h₂érh₃yom. nu só ph₂tḗr bʰéh₂t. nu h₁yós h₁ím h₂érh₃yet só h₂éǵros tósmey h₁éstu. nu h₁énos h₂pó gʷéh₂t.
english: Two sons came to their father. One said: "This field is mine." That one said: "His word is a lie. You gave it to me." The father said: "Who ploughed it?" The first said: "I ploughed it." The father said: "Let the field belong to the one who ploughed it." That one went away.

pie: mórtos bʰr̥h₁wéns wódr̥ píph₃etu. h₁yós bʰr̥h₁wéni h₃méyǵʰēti nu h₂néres tóm h₁ésmōd h₂epó h₁l̥h₂éntu. h₁yós swóm stéh₂dʰh₁om bʰréh₁wr̥ h₂éǵēti nu só ǵénh₁esey h₂ówim déwktu. bʰréh₁wr̥ kʷis mē ḱélet.
english: Let the mortal drink the water of the spring. Whoever urinates in the spring, let the men drive that man away from it. Whoever drives his own herd into the spring, let him lead a sheep to the kin. Let no one cover the spring.
